faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know to organize tutoring for your children with peace of mind.
faq.a1: Every tutor must upload official identification (Guinean National ID or Passport) and certified university diplomas. Our administrative team manually reviews every file before granting tutoring access.
faq.q2: What payment methods are supported in Guinea?
faq.a2: The platform is designed for Orange Money Guinea and MTN Mobile Money. Funds are prepaid and safely held in escrow until lessons are completed and parent-approved.
faq.q3: What happens if a lesson does not take place?
faq.a3: If a tutor does not show up or the lesson is cancelled, the parent can contest the session with one click. Funds remain locked and are never released. The administrator reviews and reschedules or refunds.
faq.q4: How can I track what my child is learning?
faq.a4: After every session, the tutor must write a structured report with topics covered, student effort, homework assigned, and teacher notes, accessible anytime in your parent portal.
faq.q5: Are lessons in-person at home or online?
faq.a5: You decide! When creating a request, you choose in-home tutoring with your neighborhood in Conakry, or online tutoring (via secure external Google Meet/Zoom link).
faq.q6: How long does it take to find a tutor?
faq.a6: Once your request is published, vetted tutors matching your criteria receive alerts. Most parents receive their first qualified applications within 24 to 48 hours.
